cues.caption: Welcome back, champ!
cues.text: Hey champ, welcome back! Ready for some more computer thinking?

cues.caption: Last time: algorithm = clear steps, in order
cues.text: Last time, you learned what an algorithm is. A clear list of steps, in order, to get a job done. Remember Robo, and his glass of water?

cues.caption: Chapter 2 · Sequencing
cues.text: Today is chapter two of Thinking Like a Computer. And it's all about one little word. Sequencing.

cues.caption: Sequencing = putting steps in the right order
cues.text: Sequencing just means putting steps in the right order. Hmm. But does the order really matter that much?

cues.caption: Order really matters. Let's see why!
cues.text: Oh, it really does! Let me tell you a funny little story, and you'll see why.

cues.caption: Running late! Robo, help me get dressed
cues.text: One morning, you're running late for school. The school bus is almost here! So you ask Robo to help you get dressed.

cues.caption: 1. Put on shoes · 2. Put on socks
cues.text: You quickly write two steps for him. Step one, put on shoes. Step two, put on socks.

cues.caption: Socks on top of the shoes! Oh no!
cues.text: Robo follows them exactly. First, the shoes go on. And then, the socks go on, right on top of the shoes! Oh no!

cues.caption: What went wrong? Think!
cues.text: So, what went wrong? Was a step missing? Think about it for a moment.

cues.caption: Nothing missing. Just the wrong order!
cues.text: Nothing was missing! Both steps were there. They were just in the wrong order. Socks have to go on first, and then the shoes.

cues.caption: Socks → Shoes. Happy feet!
cues.text: So we swap them around. Step one, socks. Step two, shoes. And now Robo gets it right. Same steps, new order, happy feet!

cues.caption: Steps in a set order = a SEQUENCE
cues.text: When steps are arranged in a set order, one after another, we call that a sequence.

cues.caption: Sequencing = the right order, so the job works
cues.text: And sequencing means putting those steps in the right order, so the job works.

cues.caption: Like stairs: one step after another
cues.text: Think of climbing the stairs. You step on the first stair, then the second, then the third. You can't start at the top! A sequence works the same way. One step, after another.

cues.caption: Order matters everywhere!
cues.text: Order matters all around you. Let's look at a few.

cues.caption: Socks first, then shoes
cues.text: Socks first, then shoes. We know that one now! The socks keep your feet comfy inside the shoes.

cues.caption: Unlock first, then open the door
cues.text: When you get home, you unlock the door first, and then you open it. You can't open a locked door!

cues.caption: Open the tiffin first, then eat!
cues.text: And at lunch, you open your tiffin box first, and then you eat. Nobody can eat through a closed lid!

cues.caption: Ask: what must happen FIRST?
cues.text: So whenever you put steps in order, ask yourself one question. What must happen first?

cues.caption: Computers do exactly the next step
cues.text: Now, here's something really important about computers. A computer does exactly the next step on its list. It doesn't guess.

cues.caption: Open, then unlock? Bonk! Still locked.
cues.text: Say Robo's steps are, open the door, then unlock the door. Robo walks up, and pulls the handle. Bonk! The door is still locked.

cues.caption: Robo won't fix the order for you
cues.text: You or I would think, oh, I should unlock it first. But Robo won't fix the order for you. He just does the next step.

cues.caption: Wrong order in → wrong result out
cues.text: So remember. If the steps go in the wrong order, the result comes out wrong too. Computers follow the list exactly as it's written. So it's our job to get the order right.

cues.caption: Scrambled = steps all mixed up
cues.text: When steps are all mixed up, we say they're scrambled. Like scrambled eggs, all jumbled together!

cues.caption: Some mix-ups are funny…
cues.text: Sometimes scrambled steps are just funny. Like socks on top of your shoes. Everyone laughs, but you still can't go to school like that!

cues.caption: …and some are broken. Splash!
cues.text: But sometimes, they're broken. Pour the water, then take a glass? Splash! Water all over the floor.

cues.caption: Swap = two steps change places
cues.text: Here's a sneaky one. When two steps change places with each other, that's called a swap. And just one swap can break the whole job, even when every single step is there.

cues.caption: Brush → Paste → Pick up? How do we fix it?
cues.text: Let's help Robo. He got these steps for brushing his teeth. One, brush teeth. Two, put paste on the brush. Three, pick up the brush. How would you fix it? Think.

cues.caption: Pick up → Paste → Brush. Sparkly clean!
cues.text: The steps were back to front! So we flip them. Pick up the brush. Then, put paste on it. Then, brush your teeth. Sparkly clean!

cues.caption: Unscramble game: lunchtime!
cues.text: Now, an unscramble game! It's lunchtime, and your tiffin is inside your school bag.

cues.caption: Which step comes first?
cues.text: Here are the steps, all mixed up. Take out the tiffin. Close the zip. Open the zip. Which one comes first? Pause, and think.

cues.caption: Open zip → Take out tiffin → Close zip
cues.text: First, open the zip. Then, take out the tiffin. And last, close the zip. Now you can eat! Yum.

cues.caption: Which step is in the wrong place?
cues.text: One more! Here's how to make nimbu pani. One, drink the juice. Two, squeeze a lemon into water. Three, add sugar and stir. Which step is in the wrong place?

cues.caption: Drink goes LAST, after the juice is made
cues.text: Drink the juice! Drinking has to be the very last step, after the juice is made. Otherwise, there's nothing to drink.

cues.caption: Squeeze → Stir → Drink. Ahh!
cues.text: Squeeze, stir, and then drink. Ahh. Nice and cool!

cues.caption: Your turn: practice check
cues.text: Okay champ, here's a practice check, just like the quiz.

cues.caption: Pour milk before opening the carton?
cues.text: If pour the milk comes before open the carton, what happens? Pause the video, and say your answer out loud.

cues.caption: No milk! Open the carton first, then pour
cues.text: No milk comes out, because the carton is still closed! The fix is easy. Open the carton first, then pour. Did you get it? Brilliant!

cues.caption: Sequencing = the right order
cues.text: Let's remember what we learned today. Sequencing means putting steps in the right order.

cues.caption: Socks before shoes, unlock before open
cues.text: Socks before shoes. Unlock before open.

cues.caption: Computers do the next step. No guessing!
cues.text: Computers do exactly the next step. They don't guess, and they won't fix the order for you.

cues.caption: Swap two steps and things can break
cues.text: And if you swap two steps, the whole job can break.

cues.caption: Chapter 2 done!
cues.text: Chapter two, done! You know that order matters. Super work, champ!

cues.caption: Next: Quiz · Tap Finish
cues.text: Now let's see what you remember. Tap Finish, and try the quiz. You've got this!
